text: You'll love this Mexican-Style Rice recipe because it combines your fondness for spicy food with a staple ingredient - rice. The addition of a fresh chili pepper gives it a bold flavor, while the vegetable or chicken stock adds depth without overpowering the dish. With a preparation time of just 30 minutes, this recipe is quick and easy to make, making it perfect for a weeknight dinner or a weekend meal. The nutrition information is also relatively balanced, so you can enjoy this dish without worrying about your dietary needs.
